standard.description: Standard balanced gear for universal power transmission.

small.description: Compact gear suitable for tight spaces and high-speed gearing.

large.description: Broad heavy gear spanning wide distances across the mechanism.

powered.description: Motorized drive gear that generates continuous rotational kinetic power.

fixed.description: Bolted to chassis; acts as anchor or receiver.

target.description: Target mechanism output that must receive kinetic power to complete the circuit.

heavy.description: High inertia gear with stable cadence.

directional.description: One-way ratcheted gear that only turns in its designated direction.

locked.description: Locked gear that prevents rotation until unlocked.
